title: How to set page parameter to start at 1 instead of 0?
body:
How do I set the trackedParameter for 'page' to start at 1 instead of 0?

so that `/search?q=searchterm&page=0` is instead `/search?q=searchterm&page=1` on the first page?

Basically I want to hook into the method that sets the querystring param, and just visually show it as +1 more than the actual page.

This could be an option using `urlSync`.

comments.body:
Not currently doable with instantsearch.js without some good hacking, mostprobably something we want to fix in the next version of instantsearch.js.

Still, we would accept any PR adding this option, it would require you hacking into https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/lib/url-sync.js and do the necessary changes.

Thanks a lot for feedback.
The proposed new API ([see PoC](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2636)) will let you do that pretty easily.
